_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "alarms" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_hour" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(local_hour BETWEEN 0 AND 23), "local_minute" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(local_minute BETWEEN 0 AND 59), "label" TEXT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "recurrence_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "repeat_days_mask" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sound_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "ringtone_uri" TEXT NULL, "ringtone_title" TEXT NULL, "adaptive_sound_rotation" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("adaptive_sound_rotation" IN (0, 1)), "increasing_volume" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("increasing_volume" IN (0, 1)), "vibration_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("vibration_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "snooze_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("snooze_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "snooze_duration_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(snooze_duration_minutes BETWEEN 1 AND 60), "definition_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "alarm_sounds" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "asset_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "sound_family" TEXT NOT NULL, "intensity_level" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(intensity_level BETWEEN 1 AND 5), "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "last_used_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "wake_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "alarm_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "scheduled_time_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "triggered_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "initial_sound_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "initial_volume" REAL NULL, "first_interaction_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "response_latency_ms" INTEGER NULL, "snooze_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sound_change_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "escalation_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "dismissed_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "outcome" TEXT NOT NULL, "wake_enforcement_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("wake_enforcement_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "current_wake_flow_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'completed', "mission_type" TEXT NULL, "mission_attempt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "mission_failure_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "wake_check_attempt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "wake_check_failure_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "confirmed_awake_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "protocol_id" TEXT NULL, "protocol_version" INTEGER NULL, "protocol_snapshot_json" TEXT NULL, "analysis_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "wake_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "wake_session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sequence_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "event_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "metadata_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "missions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "alarm_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES alarms (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "mission_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "difficulty" TEXT NOT NULL, "configuration_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mission_executions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "wake_session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wake_sessions (id), "mission_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES missions (id), "mission_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempt_number" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(attempt_number > 0), "started_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "failed_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "failure_reason" TEXT NULL, "metadata_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "wake_checks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "wake_session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wake_sessions (id), "attempt_number" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(attempt_number > 0), "scheduled_for_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "triggered_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "first_interaction_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "completed_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "wake_protocols" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "alarm_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES alarms (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version > 0), "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "initial_sound_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "initial_sound_family" TEXT NULL, "ringtone_uri" TEXT NOT NULL, "initial_volume_percent" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(initial_volume_percent BETWEEN 0 AND 100), "max_volume_percent" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(max_volume_percent BETWEEN 0 AND 100), "volume_escalation_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("volume_escalation_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "volume_escalation_step_percent" INTEGER NOT NULL, "volume_escalation_interval_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "vibration_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("vibration_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "vibration_pattern" TEXT NOT NULL, "vibration_escalation_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("vibration_escalation_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "mission_required" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("mission_required" IN (0, 1)), "mission_type" TEXT NULL, "mission_difficulty" TEXT NULL, "mission_configuration_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "wake_check_required" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("wake_check_required" IN (0, 1)), "wake_check_delay_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "wake_check_hold_milliseconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "max_wake_check_failures" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reactivation_sound_policy" TEXT NOT NULL, "intensity_level" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(intensity_level BETWEEN 1 AND 5), "reason_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "technical_explanation" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_explanation" TEXT NOT NULL, "based_on_session_id" TEXT NULL, "supersedes_protocol_id" TEXT NULL, "settings_snapshot_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "effective_from_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "protocol_evaluations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "protocol_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wake_protocols (id), "wake_session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wake_sessions (id), "result" TEXT NOT NULL, "primary_failure_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "analysis_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "selected_rule_id" TEXT NULL, "rule_trace_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "changes_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "performance_score" INTEGER NULL, "score_version" INTEGER NULL, "evaluation_notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "alarm_adaptation_settings" ("alarm_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES alarms (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "adapt_sound" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("adapt_sound" IN (0, 1)), "adapt_volume" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("adapt_volume" IN (0, 1)), "adapt_vibration" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("adapt_vibration" IN (0, 1)), "adapt_wake_check" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("adapt_wake_check" IN (0, 1)), "adapt_mission" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("adapt_mission" IN (0, 1)), "user_max_volume_percent" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100 CHECK(user_max_volume_percent BETWEEN 30 AND 100), "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("alarm_id"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX wake_events_session_sequence ON wake_events (wake_session_id, sequence_number)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX mission_executions_session_attempt ON mission_executions (wake_session_id, attempt_number)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX wake_checks_session_attempt ON wake_checks (wake_session_id, attempt_number)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX wake_protocols_alarm_version ON wake_protocols (alarm_id, version)
CREATE INDEX wake_protocols_alarm_status ON wake_protocols (alarm_id, status)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX protocol_evaluations_session ON protocol_evaluations (wake_session_id)
